subject: UNLOCK statement
notes: RULE: 'File-name-1 shall not refer to a sort file or a merge file.' - cite.py --check 14.9.47.3 'File-name-1 shall not refer to a sort file or a merge file.' -> OK §14.9.47.3 1). CODE: FileLockBinder.BindUnlock does `if (file.IsSortMerge) ctx.Edition.Error("COBOL1512", $"UNLOCK may not name the sort/merge file '{name}' (ISO §14.9.47 SR1)")`. The predicate is earned, not guessed: IsSortMerge is set at exactly one site, DataBinder.cs:1032 `sdFile.IsSortMerge = true;` when an SD (sort-merge file description entry) is bound - and §13.4.6 IS the sort-merge file description entry, so 'sort file or merge file' and 'described by an SD' are the same set (a file used only as SORT USING/GIVING is described by an FD and is correctly NOT caught). MEASURED: tests/conformance/negative/unlock-sort-file.cob compiled at --std 2002, 2014 and 2023 - each emits `error COBOL1512: UNLOCK may not name the sort/merge file 'S' (ISO §14.9.47 SR1)` and exits 70. At 85 the statement itself is COBOL0900-rejected first, so the rule has no 85 leg to test. COVERING TEST: conformance:cases/14.9.47-UNLOCK/unlock-sort-file (spec-derived form; header `*> reject-at: 2002 2014 2023` matches the measured editions exactly).
